findings.breaking_input: --day 2026-10-13 with a journal op line {work:true,phase:'apply',ok:true,op:'today.capture-idea',receipt:'<any event id on the spine whose kind is not decision.recorded but whose day is 2026-10-13>'} where that spine event was NOT written by a face op (e.g. a note.logged event from any process).
findings.why: The map `ids` stores kind and day but never checks that the event kind is the work-door apply kind, nor that the event's payload op matches the journalled op. Any non-decision event on the same day satisfies the op clause. The fixed-defect check says 'same day, the right kind, each receipt counted once' but the code only checks kind !== 'decision.recorded' — any other kind passes, including note.logged events the work door never wrote. This is the twin of the 'Membership where identity was needed' pattern: it matches by exclusion of one kind rather than by identity of the apply kind.
findings.fix: Require ev.kind to be the exact work-door apply kind (e.g. 'work.apply.recorded' or whatever the door writes), and optionally that the event payload.op equals the journalled o.op.
